body: As I stand there, the relentless blue shells seem to close in, their monotonous rhythm a stark contrast to the chaotic din of the storm raging beyond the beach. The water, once a chaotic mess of crashing waves and leaping foam, now reveals a more ominous truth: a long-forgotten graveyard of shipwrecks, their hulls worn to rust and decay. I feel the sand beneath my feet grow colder, the wind whipping my hair into a frenzy as I frantically scan for any signs of life or refuge.
